title: Arkret Invite and Contact Receive Policy
description: Subject-private policy used by a Principal Server to decide which invite delivery or first-contact request introduction evidence may notify the holder. This policy is not written into the target Realm durable event log or the public contact fact log.

subject_id.description: Stable principal did_core_id whose private invite receive policy this object configures. A long-lived principal MUST originate from did:webvh; only ak.profile.ephemeral_pairwise_principal.v1 admits a did:key principal. did:web is never a principal method.

holder_allowed_introduction_kinds.description: Allowlist of introduction evidence kinds that may reach holder notification or review.

explicit_address_behavior.description: Default behavior for explicit_address evidence. Deployments SHOULD default to quarantine or drop, not notify.

handle_claim_behavior.description: Default behavior for handle_claim evidence. Omitted means quarantine. A subject MAY set notify to allow verified handle-based requests to reach the holder, but the effective value is capped by receive_policy_constraints.

unknown_invites.description: Behavior for invite/contact delivery requests without compliant introduction_evidence.

allowed_handle_domains.description: Optional subject-private allowlist for canonical handle domains accepted as handle_claim evidence. Empty or omitted means no subject-level domain restriction; deployment constraints may still restrict the effective set.

denied_handle_domains.description: Subject-private denylist for canonical handle domains. Matches are rejected before allowed_handle_domains is evaluated.

trusted_handle_issuers.description: Optional subject-private allowlist of handle claim issuers accepted for handle_claim evidence.

trusted_directory_services.description: Optional subject-private allowlist of Directory service DIDs accepted as resolved_by for handle_claim evidence.

denied_subjects.description: Per-subject block list (peer principal DIDs). Invite delivery whose inviter is in this list MUST be dropped, and disclosure MUST be forced to opaque regardless of the disclosure policy, to avoid leaking the block via a side channel.

disclosure.description: Graded disclosure policy. Controls whether the invite/contact delivery outcome reveals a real result (delivered/blocked) to the requester, by introduction trust tier. Holder quarantine is never disclosable at any tier: it maps to status=deferred with no disclosed_outcome. Omitted means the default: high_trust=outcome, discovery_trust=opaque, low_trust=opaque.

domain_name.description: Canonical IDNA A-label domain. Subdomains are not implied; list each accepted domain explicitly.

disclosure_level.description: opaque: only a generic accepted-for-processing status is returned, indistinguishable across exists/not-exists/policy outcomes. outcome: the real delivered|blocked result is disclosed to the inviter. Neither level ever discloses holder quarantine.

high_trust.description: Disclosure level for the high-trust introduction tier: consent_grant, locator_ref, shared_realm. Default outcome.

discovery_trust.description: Disclosure level for public or restricted discovery evidence: handle_claim. Default opaque.

low_trust.description: Disclosure level for the low-trust introduction tier: same_principal_server, explicit_address, and missing/non-compliant evidence. Default opaque.

receive_policy_constraints.description: Deployment/admin upper bound applied to subject-private receive policies. The effective receive policy is the intersection of the subject policy and these constraints; constraints can only make a subject less reachable, never more reachable.

applies_to.description: Surfaces governed by this constraint object. Omitted means both invite_delivery and contact_request.

deployment_allowed_introduction_kinds.description: Maximum set of introduction evidence kinds this deployment permits. Omitted means no deployment-level kind cap.

handle_claim_max_behavior.description: Maximum behavior allowed for handle_claim evidence using the order drop < quarantine < notify.

explicit_address_max_behavior.description: Maximum behavior allowed for explicit_address evidence using the order drop < quarantine < notify.

allowed_handle_domains.description: Deployment-level allowlist for handle domains accepted as handle_claim evidence. Empty means no handle domain is accepted.
